candidates.title: G004/G005 live verification lane
candidates.why: The remaining ultragoal blockers are not code-complete blockers; they are authenticated-browser verification blockers. Agent headless session has no Firebase Auth user and cannot attach to the already-running Chrome profile without CDP.
candidates.recommendedUpdate: Add an in-app admin-only verification panel that runs split migration dry-run/write probe and media queue upload probe from the user’s logged-in browser, then copies/downloads a JSON receipt.

candidates.title: Consult form “보류 저장” naming/behavior conflict
candidates.why: There are now two different “보류” meanings: the new saved-consult 보류 tab, and the older form-local single draft stored as vsC_pending. This can confuse the exact workflow the user described.
evidence: deployed consult form still exposes 보류 저장
candidates.recommendedUpdate: Rename form-local 보류 저장 to 임시저장, clarify it as a draft, and consider multiple saved drafts or direct “save as 보류 상담” for incomplete applications.

candidates.title: Dashboard password gate consolidation
candidates.why: The app now uses Firebase admin auth, but dashboard still has a separate local password gate with initial password 0000. That is extra friction and a confusing second auth model.
evidence: index.html askDashboardPw/changeDashboardPw copy includes initial password 0000
candidates.recommendedUpdate: For verified admin sessions, bypass or retire the local dashboard password; keep an optional local privacy lock only if explicitly needed.

candidates.title: Legacy consult frequency helper cleanup
candidates.why: Function ciSetFreq(el,n) references undefined variable v. Search shows current UI uses ciFixFreq/ciFlexFreq instead, so it appears dead, but leaving it risks a future ReferenceError if reused.
candidates.recommendedUpdate: Remove ciSetFreq or correct it to use n, and add a regression invariant for consult frequency controls.

candidates.title: Missing-attendance proposal controls need skip/snooze
candidates.why: The fixed schedule collector can surface many historical weekday proposals. Confirmation now works, but operators still need a way to deliberately ignore an old non-lesson without writing 출석/결석.
evidence: deployed browser synthetic workflow surfaced two historical proposals for one fixed weekly student
candidates.recommendedUpdate: Add “이번 항목 숨김/수업 아님” with an audit record, plus date-range filter.

candidates.title: Mobile schedule summary row refinement
candidates.why: The tab-blocking issue is fixed; the summary now lives below 일별/주간. A further update can make the 미배정 list collapsible so names do not consume vertical space when there are many.
evidence: deployed mobile workflow text shows 일별/주간 then 수강중 2명 / 미배정 1명 summary row
candidates.recommendedUpdate: Make 미배정 row a compact collapsible chip with one-tap 변동 배정.
